item.scp_unleashed.scp682_remover.toolti: A Foundation override key. It does not ask permission.
item.scp_unleashed.scp682_remover.detail: Use on SCP-682 to remove it from the world for good
message.scp_unleashed.scp682_remover.cre: The override key only answers in creative mode.
message.scp_unleashed.scp682.stasis: It thrashes free. The field can't hold anything that large.
SCP-682, the "Hard-to-Destroy Reptile": a huge, regenerating reptile that hates all life. Keter-class.
It cannot be killed. Every attempt so far has ended with it getting back up.
It learns. Whatever hurts it often enough soon stops hurting it at all.
Canon containment kept it submerged in an acid bath. Staff report it is easier to manage when it is not at full size.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp682_remover.1: A creative-only override key. Use it on SCP-682 to remove it from the world for good.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp682_remover.2: It is the only clean way to be rid of it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp682.0: Something enormous is moving through deep water. Bring acid, and bring friends.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.title: Hard-to-Destroy Reptile
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.caption: SCP-682 during a scheduled acid immersion. The photographer did not stay for a second exposure.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.0.text.0: SCP-682 must be destroyed as soon as possible. No current Foundation means can achieve this, so it is contained.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.0.text.1: SCP-682 is held in a small chamber lined with reinforced, acid-resistant steel. The chamber floor is kept flooded with sulfuric acid, and the acid is to be topped up whenever it runs low.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.0.text.2: **Only Mobile Task Forces may engage SCP-682 during a breach.** Staff are not to speak to it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.0.text.3: Any attack used against SCP-682 is to be logged. %rSee Addendum 682-A.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.1.text.0: SCP-682 is a large, vaguely reptilian creature of unknown origin. Its grey hide is scarred and ragged, bony plates run down its back and tail, and its pale limbs end in long claws.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.1.text.1: It appears to hate all life. It hunts anything it can reach, on land or in water, and has broken out of every chamber that was not kept flooded.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.1.text.2: SCP-682 regenerates at extreme speed. Instances of it being reduced to near nothing have been followed, without exception, by its recovery.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.2.title: Addendum 682-A: Adaptation
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.2.text: Attacks repeated against SCP-682 lose their effect. Its hide changes visibly each time. Methods that worked in one breach are not to be assumed to work in the next. %rThe list of methods it no longer responds to is restricted.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.3.title: Addendum 682-B: Size
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.3.text: SCP-682 has been observed at several sizes. It grows back over time. Recovery teams report that a smaller SCP-682 is far easier to move, and far less able to dig its way out.
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.4.title: Addendum 682-C: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.4.text: SCP-682 surfaced in open water after a reader of this file went looking for it. Its roar was heard from a great distance. %rThe search team asked to be reassigned.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.5.title: Addendum 682-D: Interview Excerpt
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.5.text: Asked about the people it had killed, SCP-682 answered only: "They were... disgusting." The interview was ended.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp682.marked: Something else has left its mark on it
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.6.title: Addendum 682-E: Adaptation Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.682.page.6.text: Contact with other anomalous objects leaves its own marks on SCP-682. Logged so far: crystalline growths along the dorsal ridge after an incident involving SCP-409, a frost crust after an escort route passed SCP-548, and rows of bony plating along the flanks after a sustained small-arms engagement. %rFurther entries are restricted. Cross-testing SCP-682 against other anomalies is suspended pending O5 review.%r
notice.scp_unleashed.scp682.shed.detail: Part of its hide sloughs away
jade.scp_unleashed.scp682.adapted.fading: Its hide is starting to flake
jade.scp_unleashed.scp682.marked.fading: The marks on it are starting to fade
